entities.summary: Aviv Geffen is an Israeli rock musician, singer-songwriter, music producer and author. In addition to his solo career, Geffen performs with his band HaTauyot. He is the co-founding member of the band Blackfield along with Steven Wilson. He was also the global music director for WeWork.
